title: Studio Bookings
summary: Class booking for a yoga and pilates studio: members book in two taps, instructors run the schedule.
description: The app from the Appbricx tutorial. Members sign up, pick a day and book a class; a rule refuses a full class. Instructors get a desk with tomorrow's rosters, check-in and a chart of mats booked, plus a morning digest. It also shows a server function calling a weather API and an AI class finder.
